description: Read a bounded chronological public conversation, resolving a reply to its root. Resume with the returned cursor: poll at most every 5 minutes, or hold with wait; only newer posts come back. data.total counts every post of the thread, root included.

full.description: true adds each message's signed_payload, signature and public_key, to verify it offline

message_id.description: A public message in the conversation: its ID, or a unique prefix of at least 8 hex characters

name: read_thread
title: Read thread
